arf_evidence.source_family: Three validated E3 ARF/FORDE fits; same benchmark.models_arf path is used by E4 and E5. science.py passes n_jobs=1.

E5_direct_ARF.selection_source: matching E3 repetition ARF selected parameters

arf_evidence.assessment: Three matching 80,000-row phase-supervised E3 fits and 13 executed tuning phases support a provisional 6 GiB admission estimate for prospective E4 ARF tuned fits and E5 ARF fixed refits. E4 cohort class support preserves the same leaf search values. This is an admission estimate only; keep the 10 GiB hard limit and 600-second limits.

E3_synthetic_400k_reference.interpretation: Larger synthetic RF route; not an exact E4 treatment size match.

random_forest_evidence.assessment: 42 successful E4 direct RF fits provide exact 80,000x6 model-phase evidence; the weighted route has one successful 80,000x6 fit with an 80,000-vector sample weight. This supports a provisional 4 GiB admission estimate for future weighted 80,000-row E4 RF fits, retaining the 10 GiB hard limit and dynamic promotion. The 54 completed nonweighted treatment fits span 80,611 to 84,310 rows; one successful A_tenth generated-copula fit at the new maximum had 2,538,164 KiB final-phase RSS and 1,790,228 KiB maximum trial-phase RSS. This supports extending the provisional 5 GiB envelope through 84,310 rows only. No successful E4 treatment RF fit above 84,310 rows exists; planned inputs reach 125,955. The 400,000-row E3 synthetic RF results are not exact E4 treatment shape matches and include final peaks above 8 GiB, so do not lower reservations above the 84,310 observed envelope.
